narrative.overview: A neighborhood wayfinding language for medicine discovery and pharmacy operations. Blue marks actions and destinations, coral marks the key turn, yellow highlights the next step, and conventional controls keep both sides of the product familiar.
rules: Exact medicine identity and stock truth must be stated in words, not inferred from color.
Use the three-step guide only to explain the real find-nearby-ask journey.
Keep customer and pharmacy screens in one visual system.
